description: This file defines the ConsulGatewayListProvider class which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface to provide gateway addresses in a clustering setup using Consul for Orleans. It includes methods for initialization and fetching gateway URIs based on Consul membership data.

classes.name: ConsulGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements a gateway list provider using Consul for Orleans clustering, capable of initializing and retrieving gateway URIs based on Consul membership data.

methods.name: ConsulGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies from options and sets internal state.

methods.name: MaxStaleness
methods.description: Property that returns the maximum staleness duration allowed for the gateway list.

methods.name: IsUpdatable
methods.description: Property indicating whether the gateway list can be updated.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the Consul client for communication with Consul cluster.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of active gateway URIs based on Consul membership data.
